北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴空万里，体感微凉，湿度较低，记得补水保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and feels a bit cool with low humidity. Stay hydrated and warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，气温适宜。享受这美好的天气吧！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi enjoys lovely sunshine and pleasant temperatures. Have a wonderful day!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光明媚，微风轻拂。出门记得添衣，小心着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny with a gentle breeze. Don't forget an extra layer to avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州暖意融融，阳光正好。外出做好防晒，多喝水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm and sunny. Remember sun protection and stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，微风送爽。气温舒适，但要注意风力稍大。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with a refreshing breeze. Enjoy the pleasant temperature, but mind the stronger wind.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光明媚，体感偏凉。早晚温差大，请注意增减衣物。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny but feels a bit cool. Big temp difference, dress in layers.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴空万里，微风宜人。出门踏青，尽享好时光！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear and breezy. A perfect day for an outing!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阳光明媚，气温适中。出门记得带外套，注意温差。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and mild. Bring a jacket, mind the temperature changes.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阳光正好，微风拂面。湿度较高，感觉会比较舒适。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny with a gentle breeze. Higher humidity makes it feel comfortable.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阳光充足，气温舒适，但湿度只有 2%，请记得多喝水！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and pleasant, but only 2% humidity! Drink plenty of water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，气温适宜，体感舒适。出门记得带伞，以防万一。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and mild. Bring an umbrella just in case.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 0℃，注意防寒保暖，别冻着了！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like 0℃. Bundle up warmly and stay safe from the cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天风力 4级，体感较凉。出门请多穿衣，注意防风。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and windy with a cool feel. Dress warmly and mind the wind.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，体感稍凉。风力 3级，出门添衣防风哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny but feels a bit cool. With 3-level wind, dress warmly and mind the wind!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，气温舒适。风力 3级，注意海风，小心着凉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and pleasant. Mind the 3-level sea breeze and don't catch a cold.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感 4℃，风力 4级。海边风大，务必多穿衣保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like 4℃ with 4-level wind. It's windy by the sea, dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 4℃，多云有风。海边温差大，请注意防寒保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like 4℃, cloudy with wind. Big temp difference by the sea, stay warm.
